import torch.nn.functional as F

def distill_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, labels, T=2.0, alpha=0.5):
    soft_t = F.log_softmax(teacher_logits / T, dim=-1)
    soft_s = F.log_softmax(student_logits / T, dim=-1)
    kd_loss = F.kl_div(soft_s, soft_t, log_target=True, reduction="batchmean") * T * T
    ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(student_logits, labels)
    return alpha * kd_loss + (1 - alpha) * ce_loss
caption: T softens both distributions; alpha balances imitating the teacher against matching the real label.
